system.description: As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane. On a failed save, for the next minute, the Bruised condition gains the Max Ranks: 5 tag, allow it to be applied up to 5 times. A creature with more than 1 rank of Bruised increases the bonus damage they take by +4, for each rank they have beyond the first.
